request.action_description: Attack 3 of 3, the finisher: a big lunging double thrust with both needles together, long step forward with full extension, hold the final pose, then recover. STRICT SIDE VIEW every frame: facing RIGHT in profile, chest never turns toward the camera; everything moves toward the RIGHT. She never turns around. Same character in every frame exactly as the reference image: petite adult woman, pale blonde long ponytail with a blue ribbon, red bikini top, red pleated mini skirt, brown belt with a purple pouch, brown gloves, brown thigh-high boots with silver knee guards, a long thin silver sewing needle held in EACH hand like a rapier. Same face, same proportions and same size as the reference; feet stay on the same ground line. Bold outline, clean pixels. No effects, no trails, no glow on the body.
